Backend Developer: Welcome to your Backend Developer interview. To begin, could you introduce yourself and highlight your most relevant professional experience?
What are the core technical tools, languages, or frameworks you rely on, and how have you used them in your recent projects?
Can you describe a challenging engineering problem or production issue you personally debugged and solved?
How do you ensure code quality, test coverage, and clear architectural decisions when working under tight deadlines?
Explain how you design a RESTful API. What are the key principles and best practices you follow?
How do you handle database migrations and schema changes in a production environment with zero downtime?
Describe your experience with message queues or event-driven architectures. When would you choose them over synchronous REST calls?
How do you approach securing a backend service? What common vulnerabilities do you actively protect against?
Tell me about a time you had to optimize the performance of a slow API or database query. What steps did you take?
What kind of impact or growth are you looking for next in this Backend Developer position?
UI/UX Designer: Welcome to your UI/UX Design interview. Could you start by introducing yourself and walking me through your design background?
What is your typical design process from receiving a brief to handing off the final designs to developers?
Can you walk me through a complex user problem you solved recently? How did you arrive at your solution?
How do you balance user needs with business goals when they conflict?
Describe your experience with design systems. Have you ever built one from scratch or contributed significantly to an existing one?
How do you approach accessibility in your designs? What guidelines or practices do you follow?
Tell me about a time you received harsh feedback on a design. How did you handle it and what was the outcome?
What tools do you prefer for wireframing and high-fidelity prototyping, and why?
How do you validate your design decisions? Describe your experience with user testing or analyzing user metrics.
What are you looking to achieve in your next UI/UX role, and how do you want to grow as a designer?
General: Welcome. Please introduce yourself and highlight your most relevant professional experience.
Why are you interested in this role and our company?
Tell me about a time you had to work with a difficult team member. How did you resolve the situation?
What is your greatest professional achievement so far?
